result.summary: The page layout is largely intact, but a loading spinner is visibly stuck over the 'Popular right now' hero card, suggesting its image/content failed to finish loading.

issues.description: A loading spinner is displayed in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar hero image in the 'Popular right now' section, indicating stuck or slow-loading content on the home screen.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the image finishes loading or replace it with a static placeholder; investigate why the image request is stalling so users don't see an indefinite spinner.
